title: skills: one home per rule — the same rule written in three skills, "moved verbatim" stubs in data and upgrade SKILL.md, an undocumented `user-invocable` frontmatter key, and `<!-- os:check -->` coverage of 1/63 (platform) and 0/42 (query) example blocks
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAmFFuy5ap2gXYq25sy

Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed), 2026-11-07, verbatim: 「按照你的建议立卡」. Structure, not a wrong sentence: this card removes the mechanism by which the two text-fix cards' defects recur (a rule stated in three places drifts in two) and brings the published examples under the check #22059 ruling B chose. Re-read on `main` `aa3e21cc`. Report: https://claude.ai/artifact/UXUaprHxBYrXE8DfJpfRGU (P2 and P3 §18). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage grades; the seat may split per skill (fold-or-serial: one PR per skill at whole-file boundaries, the token ratchet is paid line by line).

## 1 · Duplicated rules → one owner, one-sentence cross-references elsewhere

Measured on `main` (`grep -c` per `SKILL.md`):

| Rule | Written in | Proposed owner |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `conditionalRequired` → `requiredWhen` | objectstack-data, objectstack-formula, objectstack-ui | objectstack-data (the field key); others link |
| ADR-0146 (publish-time formula refusals) | objectstack-data, objectstack-platform | objectstack-formula |
| `runAs` on hooks / flows | objectstack-automation (12 mentions), objectstack-data (4) | objectstack-automation |
| queues (`queue` capability, worker shape) | objectstack-automation (10), objectstack-data (12), objectstack-platform (5) | objectstack-platform `requires:` + one rule file |
| "Verify your work" boilerplate | 9 SKILL.md files, 6 of them twice | one sentence linking `objectstack-platform/references/operations.md#verify-your-work` |

Each duplicate is a drift source and a token-ratchet line. The lane's own rule applies: a new line with no named reader is a token tax.

## 2 · "Moved verbatim" stubs

`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (5) and `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` (3) still carry "→ Moved verbatim to …" lines and the runs of `---` they left (platform's were already cleared). They say where a section went and nothing else; the three broken anchors in the stale-teaching card are their residue. Replace each with the one-line section index entry it stands for, or delete.

## 3 · `user-invocable: false`

`skills/objectui/SKILL.md:11` (and `ui/.claude/skills/objectui-contributor`, `ui/.claude/skills/verify`) carry a frontmatter key no other published skill has, no gate lists (`check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs` tolerates it) and no document explains. Either register it in the top-level-keys gate with a sentence on who reads it, or remove it. Changing frontmatter triggers `check-skill-frame-sync` — pay it in the same PR.

## 4 · `<!-- os:check -->` coverage

#22059 ruled B: the published examples are checked by the opt-in schema/type check (`packages/spec/scripts/check-skill-examples.ts`) rather than by scored evals. Coverage today, fenced `ts`/`typescript` blocks marked:

| Skill | marked / blocks |
|:--|:--|
| objectstack-platform | 1 / 63 |
| objectstack-query | 0 / 42 |
| objectstack-data | 9 / 98 |
| objectstack-automation | 3 / 17 |
| objectstack-formula | 1 / 9 |
| objectstack-ui | 16 / 32 |
| objectui | 87 / 104 |

Every defect in the P0 text-fix card sits in an unmarked block. Mark every self-contained block; turn the fragments that teach a complete rule into compilable form (import + wrapper) where that costs under ~5 lines; leave true fragments unmarked and say so once per file. Start with data and query.

## Acceptance

- Per skill: ratchet paid (deletions shrink it), `check:skill-examples` green with the new marks, no rule lost (the seat's "砍点逐条核幸存" check: each cut rule is named with its surviving home).
- **Level:** `skills/**` (Tier H): `'@objectstack/skills': patch` changeset per PR, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Dedupe (REST search, open and closed)

- `skills duplicated rules conditionalRequired three skills` → 2, none.
- `Moved verbatim SKILL.md` → 862 (noise); #14655 closed (catalog anatomy drift, same refactor family).
- `user-invocable` → 3; #14317 closed (internal skills flight, did not touch the key).
- `"os:check" coverage skills` → 38; #22059 closed ruling B (the instrument), #14297 closed (data restructure, "3.3% example gate coverage" then).

Related: #22059, #14655, #14297, #14298, #14299.
